Identity.Login.Title: Sign in
Identity.Login.Lead: For the salon’s team. Clients book without an account.
Identity.Login.Failed: The email or password is incorrect.
Identity.Login.LockedOut: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {0} minutes.
Identity.Denied.Title: Access denied
Identity.Denied.Description: You do not have access to this page. Ask the salon owner if you need it.
Identity.SignUp.Title: Start your salon
Identity.SignUp.Lead: Your salon's diary, clients, price list and till in one place. Fill this in once and you are in.
Identity.SignUp.SlugHint: Letters, digits and hyphens, {0} to {1} characters. It becomes your booking address, so pick something clients recognise.
Identity.SignUp.CountryHint: This sets your time zone, language and currency.
Identity.SignUp.Done.Title: Your salon is ready
Identity.SignUp.Done.Heading: {0} is ready
Identity.SignUp.Done.Lead: Sign in with the email and password you just chose. The first page shows what is set up and what is left, step by step.
Identity.SignUp.Validation.SalonNameTooL: Use at most {0} characters for the salon's name.
Identity.SignUp.Validation.SlugInvalid: The web address can have letters, digits and hyphens, {0} to {1} characters, such as studio-20.
Identity.SignUp.Validation.SlugTaken: That web address is taken. Pick another.
Identity.SignUp.Validation.NameTooLong: Use at most {0} characters for your name.
Identity.SignUp.Validation.EmailInvalid: Enter an email such as name@example.com.
Identity.Team.Title: Team logins
Identity.Team.Lead: Who can sign in to this salon, and as what. People who take bookings but never sign in live on the Staff pages.
Identity.Team.Add.Lead: Type a starting password and hand it over in person. The person can change it from their own login later.
Identity.Team.Name: Name
Identity.Team.RoleHint: An owner can do everything, a manager everything but settings and money corrections, a receptionist runs the diary and the till, staff see their own day without client contact details.
Identity.Team.StartingPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. Hand it over in person; it is theirs to change.
Identity.Team.NewPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the password as it is. A new one signs the person out everywhere.
Identity.Team.LastOwnerNote: This is the salon's only owner login: it cannot be demoted or turned off. Add another owner first.
Identity.Team.Validation.NameTooLong: Use at most {0} characters for the name.
Identity.Team.Validation.EmailRequired: Enter the email they will sign in with.
Identity.Team.Validation.EmailInvalid: Enter an email such as name@example.com.
Identity.Team.Validation.EmailTaken: This salon already has a login with that email, on or turned off.
Identity.Team.Validation.LastOwner: The salon must keep at least one active owner login. Add another owner first.
Identity.Password.Title: Your password
Identity.Password.Lead: Your login, your password. Changing it signs you out on every other device; this one stays signed in.
Identity.Password.Changed: Your password has been changed. Every other device was signed out.
Identity.Password.Validation.CurrentWron: That is not your current password.
Identity.Password.Validation.SameAsCurre: The new password is the same as the current one.
Identity.Password.Validation.ConfirmMism: The two new passwords do not match.
